templates.title: Rural Roads Fund Act
templates.summary: Sends federal money to repave and widen rural and small-town roads; drivers outside the cities win, and urban taxpayers foot part of the bill.

templates.title: Carbon Levy Adjustment Act
templates.summary: Raises the carbon levy each year and returns most of it as rebates; city commuters on transit come out ahead while long-distance rural and northern drivers pay more.

templates.title: Farm-Gate Fuel Exemption Act
templates.summary: Exempts diesel and propane used on farms from the carbon levy, saving farmers money at the cost of a smaller climate fund.

templates.title: {province} Ports Modernization Act
templates.summary: Funds new cranes, berths and rail spurs at {province}'s main ports so exporters can ship more, paid for out of general revenue.

templates.title: Regional Rail Rationalization Act
templates.summary: Closes money-losing rural branch rail lines and moves the savings into urban commuter rail; city riders win and small towns lose their train.

templates.title: Urban Transit Capital Fund Act
templates.summary: Creates a permanent fund for subway, light rail and bus lanes in large cities, benefiting urban riders while rural areas see little of it.

templates.title: Coastal Fisheries Quota Act
templates.summary: Cuts groundfish quotas to rebuild collapsing stocks; conservationists cheer while coastal fishing towns lose income for years.

templates.title: Northern Housing Partnership Act
templates.summary: Funds thousands of new homes in remote northern communities where overcrowding is worst, at significant federal cost.

templates.title: Westward Pipeline Approval Act
templates.summary: Approves a new oil pipeline from the prairies to the west coast; energy workers and producers win, while environmental groups and coastal opponents lose.

templates.title: {province} Mill Restructuring Assistance Act
templates.summary: Gives a struggling {province} paper mill a subsidy package to keep it open, saving local jobs with public money.

templates.title: Firearms Safe Storage and Licensing Act
templates.summary: Tightens firearm licensing, mandates locked storage and bans several rifle models; urban voters back it while rural hunters and farmers feel targeted.

templates.title: Safer Streets Sentencing Act
templates.summary: Brings back mandatory minimum sentences for repeat violent and gun offences, which pleases law-and-order voters and alarms civil liberties groups.

templates.title: Immigration Levels Plan Act
templates.summary: Raises permanent immigration targets to fill labour shortages; employers and newcomer communities win while critics warn of pressure on housing.

templates.title: Immigration Stabilization Act
templates.summary: Lowers immigration targets for three years to ease housing and service pressure, disappointing employers and newcomer communities.

templates.title: Public Pension Enhancement Act
templates.summary: Increases the public pension for low-income seniors, funded by higher payroll contributions from working people and employers.

templates.title: Pension Age Modernization Act
templates.summary: Gradually raises the public pension age from 65 to 67 to save money, hitting workers in physical jobs hardest.

templates.title: Coastal Patrol Vessel Procurement Act
templates.summary: Orders a new fleet of coastal patrol ships built in domestic shipyards, bringing jobs to coastal regions at a high price tag.

templates.title: National Arts Endowment Act
templates.summary: Creates a permanent endowment for theatres, orchestras and galleries, mostly in big cities, funded from general revenue.

templates.title: Gig Worker Fair Treatment Act
templates.summary: Amends the Labour Code so app-based delivery and ride drivers get minimum wage and benefits, raising costs for platform companies and their customers.

templates.title: Rent Relief Benefit Act
templates.summary: Pays a monthly top-up to low-income renters, mostly helping city tenants, at a large cost to the treasury.

templates.title: Housing Supply Acceleration Act
templates.summary: Ties federal infrastructure money to cities cutting development fees and red tape so builders can put up homes faster; neighbours who oppose density lose out.

templates.title: Small Business Tax Relief Act
templates.summary: Cuts the small business tax rate, helping local shops and contractors while reducing federal revenue.

templates.title: Regulatory Red Tape Reduction Act
templates.summary: Scraps two regulations for every new one and shortens permit timelines, pleasing business owners and worrying consumer and safety advocates.

templates.title: Rural Hospital Consolidation Act
templates.summary: Closes small rural hospitals and folds their budgets into larger urban regional centres; city patients get shorter waits while rural patients drive hours for care.

templates.title: Pharmacare Framework Act
templates.summary: Sets up a national plan covering essential prescription drugs, saving families money while costing the treasury billions and squeezing private insurers.

templates.title: Post-Secondary Tuition Freeze Act
templates.summary: Freezes tuition at colleges and universities for four years and backfills their budgets, helping students and costing taxpayers.

templates.title: Rural Connectivity Act
templates.summary: Pays to bring high-speed internet to every rural and remote household within five years, funded from general revenue.

templates.title: Northern Resource Corridor Act
templates.summary: Fast-tracks mine roads and power lines in the north by shortening environmental reviews; northern jobs grow while conservation groups object.

templates.title: Coal Power Phase-Out Act
templates.summary: Requires all coal-fired power plants to close by the end of the decade, cutting emissions but costing jobs in coal towns.

templates.title: Ardenmark Free Trade Implementation Act
templates.summary: Implements a free trade deal with Ardenmark that helps exporters and lowers prices, but opens dairy and poultry farmers to foreign competition.

templates.title: Supply Management Protection Act
templates.summary: Bars future trade negotiators from giving away any more of the dairy, egg and poultry market, protecting farm incomes and keeping grocery prices higher.

templates.title: Veterans Benefits Restoration Act
templates.summary: Restores lifelong disability pensions for injured veterans that were replaced by lump sums, at a large long-term cost.

templates.title: Veterans Service Modernization Act
templates.summary: Closes small-town veterans' service offices and moves services online and to city hubs, saving money but leaving rural veterans further from help.

templates.title: {province} Highway Twinning Act
templates.summary: Funds twinning a dangerous two-lane highway in {province}, improving safety for commuters and truckers at federal expense.

templates.title: Congestion Charge Enabling Act
templates.summary: Lets big cities charge drivers to enter downtown and spend the money on transit; downtown residents gain while suburban commuters pay every day.

templates.title: Postal Network Modernization Act
templates.summary: Closes hundreds of rural post offices and invests the savings in urban parcel hubs, speeding city deliveries while small towns lose a local service.

templates.title: Child Care Spaces Act
templates.summary: Funds tens of thousands of new low-fee child care spaces, helping working parents at a high public cost.

templates.title: Medical Assistance in Dying Expansion Act
templates.summary: Widens eligibility for medically assisted dying, which advocates call compassionate and religious and disability groups strongly oppose.

templates.title: Online Harms Act
templates.summary: Forces social media platforms to remove hateful and exploitative content within a day, protecting users but raising free speech concerns.

templates.title: Border Security Enhancement Act
templates.summary: Hires more border officers and speeds up removal of failed asylum claimants, pleasing enforcement advocates and angering refugee groups.

templates.title: Temporary Foreign Worker Reform Act
templates.summary: Caps temporary foreign worker permits to push employers to hire locally, which unions support and farms and processing plants fear.

templates.title: Fishing Licence Owner-Operator Act
templates.summary: Bans corporations from controlling inshore fishing licences so they stay with independent harvesters, angering large processors.

templates.title: Grain Transportation Act
templates.summary: Caps what railways can charge to haul grain and fines them for delays, helping prairie farmers at the railways' expense.

templates.title: Wildlife Protected Areas Expansion Act
templates.summary: Sets aside large new protected areas for endangered species, closing them to logging, mining and some hunting.

templates.title: Drug Decriminalization Pilot Act
templates.summary: Lets cities run pilots where possession of small amounts of drugs is treated as a health issue rather than a crime.

templates.title: Public Service Spending Restraint Act
templates.summary: Freezes public service wages and hiring for two years to cut the deficit, angering federal unions.

templates.title: Infrastructure Bank Wind-Down Act
templates.summary: Shuts down the federal infrastructure bank and returns its unspent money to the treasury, cancelling several planned projects.

templates.title: {region} Hydro Interconnect Act
templates.summary: Funds new transmission lines so the {region} can share clean hydro power between provinces, paid for by federal taxpayers.

templates.title: Fall Economic Statement Implementation Act
templates.summary: Enacts the government's fall spending package on housing and affordability; a confidence vote that could topple the government if defeated.

templates.title: Fiscal Restraint and Deficit Reduction Act
templates.summary: Cuts program spending across departments to balance the budget within three years; a confidence vote that could bring down the government.

templates.title: Rural Ambulance Response Standards Act
templates.summary: Sets national target times for ambulances to reach rural callers and requires provinces to report how often they miss them.

templates.title: Merchant Mariners Remembrance Day Act
templates.summary: Creates a national day honouring wartime merchant sailors; symbolic and cheap, but popular with veterans' groups.

templates.title: Farmer Mental Health Strategy Act
templates.summary: Requires the health minister to produce a national plan for farmer mental health and suicide prevention.

templates.title: Right to Repair Act
templates.summary: Forces manufacturers to sell parts, tools and software so farmers and independent shops can fix equipment themselves.

templates.title: Surplus Federal Buildings for Housing Act
templates.summary: Requires empty federal buildings and land to be offered first for affordable housing before they are sold.

templates.title: Credit Card Swipe Fee Cap Act
templates.summary: Caps the fees banks charge merchants on card payments, saving small shops money at the banks' expense.

templates.title: Hunting and Angling Heritage Act
templates.summary: Recognizes hunting, trapping and fishing as protected heritage activities, which rural voters love and animal-welfare groups oppose.

templates.title: Firearms Owner Rights Act
templates.summary: Repeals the recent rifle ban and simplifies licence renewals, delighting rural gun owners and outraging urban gun-control advocates.

templates.title: Animal Cruelty Penalties Act
templates.summary: Raises penalties for animal cruelty and bans puppy mills, with farm groups worried it could reach livestock practices.

templates.title: Seniors' Fraud Protection Act
templates.summary: Adds tougher sentences for scams targeting the elderly and requires banks to flag suspicious withdrawals.

templates.title: Small-Town Library and Museum Access Act
templates.summary: Creates a small grant program for libraries and museums in towns under 20,000 people.

templates.title: Apprenticeship Tax Credit Act
templates.summary: Gives employers a tax credit for each apprentice they hire in the skilled trades.

templates.title: Gig Worker Tip Protection Act
templates.summary: Stops delivery apps from keeping any part of customers' tips and requires them to show workers what they earned.

templates.title: Heritage Rail Corridor Preservation Act
templates.summary: Bans railways from tearing up abandoned rural lines so they can be restored or turned into trails.

templates.title: Northern Residents Deduction Increase Act
templates.summary: Raises the tax deduction for people living in remote northern areas to offset the high cost of living.

templates.title: Foreign Buyer Ban Extension Act
templates.summary: Extends the ban on foreign buyers of homes indefinitely, which housing advocates support and developers oppose.

templates.title: Fishing Vessel Safety Act
templates.summary: Requires life-saving gear and stability checks on small fishing boats, with a rebate to help owners pay for them.

templates.title: Military Family Support Act
templates.summary: Guarantees health-care and school continuity for military families when they are moved between provinces.

templates.title: Rural Property Crime Act
templates.summary: Makes theft and break-ins on farms and rural properties an aggravating factor at sentencing.

templates.title: Protected Bike Lane Standards Act
templates.summary: Ties federal road money to building protected bike lanes, popular with city cyclists and resented by rural drivers who see no benefit.

templates.title: Gas Tax Holiday Act
templates.summary: Suspends the federal fuel excise tax for the summer, saving drivers money and cutting transit and road funding.

templates.title: Credential Recognition for Newcomers Act
templates.summary: Sets a 90-day deadline for regulators to assess foreign professional credentials so trained newcomers can work in their fields.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Cancel the carbon levy increase
templates.summary: Calls on the government to scrap the scheduled carbon levy increase, which rural drivers cheer and climate-focused city voters oppose.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to restore rural passenger rail
templates.summary: Asks the government to bring back passenger trains to small-town lines that were cut, at a cost to the transit budget.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Emergency rent freeze
templates.summary: Calls for a two-year federal rent freeze in exchange for housing funds, which tenants welcome and landlords and builders fight.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to cut payroll taxes for small employers
templates.summary: Asks the government to lower payroll contributions for businesses with fewer than 50 staff, reducing revenue for pension and job programs.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Condemn defence procurement delays
templates.summary: Condemns years of delays buying new equipment for the armed forces and demands a firm delivery schedule.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to protect supply management in all trade talks
templates.summary: Asks the government to promise no more dairy and poultry concessions in future trade deals, keeping farm incomes and grocery prices up.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Lower immigration targets until housing catches up
templates.summary: Calls for immigration targets to be cut until housing starts catch up, appealing to squeezed suburban homebuyers and alarming newcomer communities.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to establish universal pharmacare
templates.summary: Asks the government to cover all prescription drugs under a single public plan, saving families money at a large public cost.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Repeal the firearms buyback
templates.summary: Calls for an end to the mandatory rifle buyback and refunds to owners, a rallying cry in rural ridings and a red flag in cities.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to reopen veterans' service offices
templates.summary: Asks the government to reopen closed small-town veterans' offices so veterans can get help in person.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to lift the groundfish moratorium
templates.summary: Calls for the commercial groundfish fishery to reopen, which coastal towns want and scientists warn could wipe out recovering stocks.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Fund northern airstrips and winter roads
templates.summary: Calls for a dedicated fund to keep remote northern airstrips and ice roads open year-round.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to revoke the pipeline approval
templates.summary: Asks the government to cancel its approval of the new oil pipeline, pleasing environmentalists and enraging energy workers.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Index pensions to wages, not prices
templates.summary: Calls for public pensions to rise with wages instead of prices, giving seniors bigger increases at a growing cost to younger workers.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to redirect arts subsidies to seniors' care
templates.summary: Asks the government to cut big-city arts grants and spend the money on long-term care beds, splitting cultural and rural voters.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Fix the highways before building more transit
templates.summary: Calls for highway repair money to come before any new urban transit funding, a clear choice between rural drivers and city riders.

templates.title: That the House call on the government to cap tuition increases
templates.summary: Asks the government to tie university transfer payments to a cap on tuition hikes, helping students and squeezing schools.

templates.title: Opposition motion: Restore police funding for transit safety
templates.summary: Calls for more police officers on city transit systems after a string of violent incidents, which civil liberties groups say misses the root causes.

templates.title: Main Estimates
templates.summary: Approves the government's planned spending for every department this year; losing it would bring down the government.

templates.title: Supplementary Estimates (A)
templates.summary: Approves extra spending since the Main Estimates, mostly for defence and emergency relief; a confidence vote.

templates.title: Supplementary Estimates (B)
templates.summary: Approves mid-year top-ups for housing programs and disaster recovery; a confidence vote.

templates.title: Supplementary Estimates (C)
templates.summary: Approves the last spending adjustments of the fiscal year, including veterans' benefits that ran over budget; a confidence vote.

templates.title: Budget Implementation Act
templates.summary: Puts the government's budget into law, from tax changes to new programs; defeat would trigger an election.

templates.title: Ways and Means motion on the budget
templates.summary: Approves the tax measures in the budget and is the House's first verdict on it; a defeat would bring down the government.

templates.title: Address in Reply to the Speech from the Throne
templates.summary: Endorses the government's agenda as set out in the Speech from the Throne; the first confidence test of a new parliament.

templates.title: Interim Supply Act
templates.summary: Lets the government keep paying pensions, salaries and bills for the first months of the year until the full estimates pass; a confidence vote.

templates.title: Borrowing Authority Act
templates.summary: Raises the cap on how much the government can borrow to fund its infrastructure plans; a confidence vote opponents use to attack the deficit.

templates.title: Ways and Means motion on the Fall Economic Statement
templates.summary: Approves the tax changes announced in the fall economic update; a confidence vote.
